Here's What $450,000 Buys You in West Temple, Texas. Temple, Texas Homes for Sale!
Welcome to your dream home in the highly sought-after Reserve at Pea Ridge in Temple, Texas! This immaculate 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom home just had a massive $10,000 price reduction, and it's packed with features buyers are searching for in 2025.

Located in Belton ISD, just 5 minutes from Belton Lake, this home offers a rare three-car garage, nearly half-acre lot, and plenty of space between neighbors — a true find in today's market!
Inside, you’ll find:
✅ Open-concept layout
✅ Grand entryway with high ceilings
✅ Chef’s kitchen with granite countertops & mosaic backsplash
✅ Massive kitchen island + farmhouse touches
✅ Ceramic tile flooring (no LVP!)
✅ Primary suite with luxury bathroom + huge walk-in shower
✅ Covered back patio + deck + room for a pool
✅ Built in 2021 – move-in ready!

Whether you're relocating to Central Texas, investing in real estate, or just love house tours, this one is a must-watch. Don’t miss your chance to own this beautiful property in West Temple.
📍 Address: 7511 Wind Chime Way, Temple, TX
💰 Price: $465,000
📅 Year Built: 2021
📐 Lot Size: Approx. 0.45 Acres
🛏️ Bedrooms: 5 | 🛁 Bathrooms: 3
🎓 School District: Belton ISD
